secrets.name: The Crow's Nest
secrets.text: Inside the pencil with the broken point, a stair; at the top, the splintered crown, and the points of all the others around you like a sea of spires. Someone has carved initials in the wood.

meta.label: The Pencil Wood
meta.blurb: A wood of pencils, all sharpened, standing in their own shavings. It smells of cedar and of school. Nobody has written anything with them yet.
